verdict.rationale: Wave documents automatic categorization of imported bank transactions on the Pro Plan, which covers the core of automatic categorization for imported transactions. Nothing in the evidence shows these are suggestions the user reviews, or that the system learns from user corrections or rules. Missing for 10: evidence that categorization learns from user corrections, documentation of a suggestion/review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
